Ms.Seema Jaiswal - P.L. appearing on behalf of respond  ORDER Heard on this first bail application filed by applicant- Neeraj under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita for grant of bail.

2. The applicant is in jail since 31.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.280/2024, registered at Police Station- Devari, District- Sagar for the offence under Sections 354(D) and 376 (1) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

3 . As per the case of the prosecution, allegations against the present applicant is that on 31.05.2024 at about 1:00 am during night prosecutrix had gone out of house for attending nature's call and at that time applicant came and caught hold the prosecutrix and thrown her on the ground and established physical relationship against her will.
4 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that prosecutrix is aged about 17 years 01 month.
It is a consent of long relationship.
Applicant is in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46147 2 MCRC-38435-2024 jail since 31.05.2024.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned PL for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.

sentences.text: Having regard to facts and circumstances of the case, including nature of evidence, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

7 . It is directed that the applicant - Neeraj be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8 . M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
